title: poa alpina subsp. insularis
intro: Poa alpina subsp. insularis, commonly known as the Island Alaska blue grass, is a subspecies of perennial grass native to the Arctic tundra regions of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Poa alpina subsp. insularis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit neuroprotective effects, which may be beneficial for individuals with anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that have been identified in its leaves and stems.
